recipe.title: Cover overlapping nonclinical hospital posts
recipe.scenario: Assign three people to three support posts during one fixed block. Each person can cover at most one post and can only cover posts for which they are already available and cleared by the facility. This synthetic example does not determine clinical staffing, qualifications, staffing ratios, breaks, or coverage across blocks.

field.name: post-labels
field.description: Posts in order: Visitor desk, Supply desk, Courier intake.

field.name: staff-labels
field.description: Synthetic staff labels in zero-based order: Staff A, Staff B, Staff C.

field.name: eligible-pairs
field.description: Consecutive post and staff index pairs: 0,0; 0,1; 1,2; 2,0; 2,1. Eligibility is supplied, not inferred.

field.name: preferred-visitor-desk-staff
field.description: Optional preferred staff index for Visitor desk. The example prefers Staff B (1). This does not override eligibility.

field.name: assigned-staff
field.description: For a feasible plan, one staff index per post. The preferred example yields 1,2,0 in post order.
